purpose: One end-to-end run of make e2e-composed with a FlashProve proof of the LLM answer in place of SASH's, and the two failed attempts before it. It replaces the statement 'end_to_end: not run' in flashprove-tinyllama-capped-runs-2026-11-27.json.
made_by: the contributor's AI-assisted session on the contributor's laptop; no independent reviewer

authority.statement: Local CPU work only; nothing paid, no hosted job. The owner has not reviewed or accepted this run.

command: make e2e-composed CLASSIFIER_RUN=<classifiers/composed of the owner's reference records> LLM_BACKEND=flashprove FLASHPROVE_TINYLLAMA_CASE=<the published proof files>

classifier_run.source: reference-records.tar.gz of the owner's release circle-reference-2026-10-28, folder classifiers/composed
classifier_run.note: docs/COMPOSED-DEMO.md's documented reuse: only the two frozen quantizations are taken; the three classifier proofs were made and verified afresh

attempts.error: ValueError: selected quantization pin mismatch: mlp-training/seed-17/quantization.json
attempts.reading: Not from this branch: see training_on_main. Fresh MLP training on this host gives the pinned integer weights but another checkpoint hash, which the quantization file carries.

passed_before_failing: three classifier proofs made and freshly verified
attempts.cause: A fault of this branch: the FlashProve check wrote its builds (about 1.5 GB) below the composed evidence folder, and the join's output budget of 256 MiB counts every file there. The tests used stand-in checks and did not see it.
attempts.fix: aeab4a9b16cc57de3f1ce2b77f7c925cdd608ecc gives the check its own run folder, as verify_llm.run has

attempts.final_line: INTEGRITY PASS: 1 FlashProve + 3 Circle classifier proofs.

result.llm_commitment_id_source: stated by the caller; not recomputed here
result.llm_verifier: Hallmark's patched cp_verify; upstream's refuses this proof
result.prompt: Name the capital of France in one short sentence.
result.response: The capital of France is Paris.

not_shown: fresh classifier training that passes the pin on this host: the passing runs reused the two frozen quantizations
more than one run, host or request
anything about the commitment ID: it is an enrolled value that no CPU program recomputes
a release decision: policy_release is false and the backend is not qualified

training_on_main.what: make e2e on main (e2cc6d67a0868fb21e9e6ff3bc9aa71567d5e161), unchanged, on the same host, after the three attempts
training_on_main.error: ValueError: selected quantization pin mismatch: mlp-training/seed-17/quantization.json
training_on_main.mlp_difference_from_the_reference_file: one field: checkpoint (a867779eacd1723539f7e445c16f79a7b6dec8336f73419fc72129606419f11e here, 060b55ad36e0ad5f7ea9eb6eae2a6054a8294c6fa11b2dba636cd5ce5d4d76ad in the reference); every integer weight is equal
same_as_the_reference_log: first_epoch_loss and final_loss of the three seeds, to every printed digit
the seven integer scores of each seed
training_on_main.reading: The float checkpoint differs in bits that neither the printed losses nor the quantized weights show. numpy 2.5.4 is built against Apple's Accelerate here, which comes with the system, so the system version is the likelier cause than the chip. Neither was isolated: no second host was tried.

sash_path_on_this_branch.why: The branch gives five scripts of the SASH composed path a backend argument. Until this run only tests had shown that the default path still works.
sash_path_on_this_branch.command: make e2e-composed LLM_RUN=<proofs.tar.gz and proof-inventory.json of the owner's release circle-reference-2026-10-28> CLASSIFIER_RUN=<its classifiers/composed>
sash_path_on_this_branch.final_line: INTEGRITY PASS: 23 SASH + 3 Circle classifier proofs.
